text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe on Sunday took a swipe at some of his cabinet ministers, describing them as weak and slow to implement decisions and unable to supervise their staff effectively.

- Zimbabwe's war veterans association has recommended to the ruling ZANU-PF party that a former freedom fighter and diplomat, Gaylord Hlatshwayo, who died in Italy last week be declared a national hero.
